title: Naïve, which provides infrastructure for AI agents to handle most business operations, raised a $28.5M Series A led by Nexus, bringing its total funding to $32M (Ram Iyer/TechCrunch)
summary: Ram Iyer / TechCrunch: Naïve, which provides infrastructure for AI agents to handle most business operations, raised a $28.5M Series A led by Nexus, bringing its total funding to $32M — Developers detest drudgery. The entire field of programming is proof of how hard people will work to automate away the boring tasks involved in building things.
